action_tariff_schedule.do_not_add_to_compute: Tariff sums are separate policy-accounting values and cannot be added to seconds, CPU or bytes.
action_tariff_schedule.unit: declared task utility units; no monetary conversion

feedback_confirmation.native_count_scope: native_accounting counts evaluation calls. The additional original-native ticks replayed by independent audits are listed separately and are not charged twice to evaluation.
feedback_confirmation.non_additivity: Policy, native roundtrip, native tick and archive durations are nested in SUMMARY wall. Tick is nested in roundtrip. Independent audit is a separate interval. The evaluation-plus-audit sum is only a known nonoverlapping subtotal, not a whole-driver total.
feedback_confirmation.timer_boundaries: SUMMARY wall/cpu covers evaluate_feedback_chain including episode transport, model calls, aggregation, archive creation/member verification/cleanup. Driver dataset creation, ROWS/SUMMARY persistence and independent audit lie outside it.

main_confirmation.missing_total: seed_11_student_t has no valid scope total after ENOTEMPTY cleanup recovery. All original per-episode wall/CPU/tariff and the evaluation/audit intervals remain available. No total is imputed.
main_confirmation.non_additivity: Prediction and policy times, and native roundtrip time, are nested within evaluation_wall_ns. Audit outer time is nested in scope_total; audit internal time is nested in audit outer time. Remaining outer interval includes serialization/analysis/archive/cleanup and is not a standalone archive timer.
main_confirmation.scope: 15 seed/law scopes; 49,920 policy episodes and 34,560 stored prediction rows (each prediction row contains three horizons).
main_confirmation.timer_boundaries: evaluation_wall_ns starts before scope directory/data creation and ends after prediction/control evaluation, before summary/analysis writes, independent audit and archiving. scope_total adds those later steps through cleanup. Native counters cover evaluation calls only; audit replay is outside those counters.

measurement_context.aggregation: Sums combine recorded operation intervals; concurrent work prevents interpreting sums as a single elapsed project timeline.
measurement_context.engineering_total_cost: Not estimated. Training/prototyping/debugging, unrecorded orchestration, relocation, recovery, and reporting are not a complete development engineering budget.
measurement_context.mixed_execution_environment: The first three main scopes were executed under the workspace; the following twelve main scopes and feedback/retention artifacts were retained under /tmp. Concurrent jobs shared CPU and I/O resources.
measurement_context.performance_inference: Do not attribute latency differences to the model alone or compare these measurements as controlled hardware benchmarks.
measurement_context.qualification: shared host measured; not an isolated hardware benchmark

operational_recovery.cost_handling: The affected enclosing scope duration remains null. No training/evaluation rerun or timing replacement is performed; extra recovery wall/CPU cost is unavailable.
operational_recovery.reason: shutil.rmtree raised ENOTEMPTY after complete scoring, independent audit, archive creation and member verification

reporting_compatibility.reason: NumPy quantile cannot subtract Boolean severe-loss indicators
reporting_compatibility.transformation: severe_loss Boolean -> exact float64 0/1 in temporary derived input only
reporting_compatibility.utility_effect: Only temporary severe-loss Boolean indicators were represented as exact float64 0/1 for NumPy reporting. Original utility, decisions, paid tariff, predictions, timing, and frozen inputs were unchanged.

retention.scope: Five seeds, three registered supervised retention windows, two optimizer arms per window. Only the retained optimizer-plus-immediate-receipt timer is reported; history construction, scoring, artifact writing, whole-window and CPU timers were not retained. This is not production uptime or indefinite retention.

time_and_cost_definitions.missing: null means not retained/measured for that timer boundary; it never means zero.
time_and_cost_definitions.native_roundtrip: Python persistent-process request intervals including serialization, pipe I/O, native work, response parsing, and scheduling.
time_and_cost_definitions.native_tick_timer: Retained native_ns measured around original sparse_tick and bookkeeping before the Rust timer sample; not pure CPU time or an isolated hardware kernel measurement.
time_and_cost_definitions.non_tick_residual: Native adapter roundtrip minus tick timer, encompassing several bookkeeping and IPC components; not solely IPC latency.
time_and_cost_definitions.parent_cpu: Original Python process_time_ns intervals, including same-process threads and extension code; separate Rust subprocess CPU is not measured.
time_and_cost_definitions.policy_wall: Sum of original per-episode elapsed_ns, including actual observation/delivery readbacks and decision/scoring work within the episode timer.
time_and_cost_definitions.tariff: Declared utility-unit action charges, distinct from compute time, CPU, artifact bytes and currency.

training_costs_reference.separation: The training report is unchanged. Neither report is a full development engineering cost estimate.
